title: Numerical simulation and optimization of BaZrSe3/ZnS heterojunction solar cells: achieving high performance
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,39898-39908
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05711F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Elsammani Ali Shokralla, Arslan Ashfaq, Ubaid Ur Rehman, Hind Albalawi, Zahra Bayhan, Sarah A. Alsalhi, Shoug M. Alghamdi, M. Musa Saad H.-E.
SCAPS-1D simulations of ZnO:Al/ZnO/ZnS/BaZrSe3/Au solar cells show optimal absorber thickness (2.0 μm), buffer (20 nm), doping, and contacts, yielding 29.46% PCE. BaZrSe3 emerges as a promising lead-free absorber.
